senses.gloss: (√בס, בש, cmp. בָּשַׁל, to boil, ripen, be warm, ferment) to be sweet, pleasant, pleasing.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">Lam. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>יערב לך ויִבְסַם לך</he> may (the sacrifice) be sweet unto thee (Moloch), may it be pleasing unto thee.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:14">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>יערב לכם יבושם וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 144">Yalk. Gen. 144</cite>, Josh. 35 <he>יבסם</he>) may (the wine you drank) be sweet to you, may it well agree with you.—Denom. <he>בּוֹסֶם</he>.

senses.gloss: , בִּישֵּׂם to make a person look well, esp. (denom. of בּוֹסֶם) to perfume with oil &c.
units: Ex. R. s. 23 a bride מקשטין אותה ומְבַסְּמִין אותה is adorned and made handsome (her toilet is attended to).—Part. pass. מְבוּסָּם, f. מְבוּסֶּמֶת, מְבוּשּׂ׳ perfumed, sweet &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:7">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מקושטת ומב׳</he> in full toilet.

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 6:5">Tosef. Ber. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:5">V</cite>), 5 it is not becoming for a scholar <he>שיצא מבוסם</he> to go out with perfumed oil on his head; <cite ref="Berakhot 43b:11">Ber. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>מבוש׳</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 6:3">B. Bath. VI, 3</cite> <he>יין מב׳</he> sweet wine (guaranteed as not sour). [<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> <he>בישם העולם</he>; Ruth. R. beg. <he>ביסם</he>, read <cite ref="B01007"><he>בִּיסֵּס</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B01007"><he>בָּסַס</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to become exhilarated, to feel the wine.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> <he>אכל ושתה ונת׳</he> he ate and drank and felt well.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:13">Gen. R. s. 67</cite>, end <he>נִתְבַּסְּמָה דעתו עליו</he> his character grew better (play on <he>בשמת</he> <cite ref="Genesis 26:34">Gen. XXVI, 34</cite>).—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 66:6">Gen. R. s. 66</cite> <he>נתבשם העולם</he>, v. <cite ref="B01007"><he>בָּסַס</he></cite>.]
